text:
Sam: Starting thread to track APAC GPU region bring-up (ap-southeast-1). Main goals: bootstrap VPC + infra modules, wire TF/Pulumi state, CI gating, validation runbook, and SRE handoff. Keep updates short here.
Anya: High-level plan: 1) VPC + subnet placement + endpoint config, 2) EKS cluster and GPU nodegroups (mixed spot/on-demand), 3) state backend + locking, 4) CI pipelines for plan/approve/deploy, 5) smoke validation + handoff doc.
Kevin: Filed quota ticket #5621 for GPUs. Requested: 12x A100-40GB + 4x A40 across two AZs. ETA 72h. Ticket link: https://support.cloud/5621
Sam: Can you paste the quota request text?
Kevin: Posted template, copy below:
```
Region: ap-southeast-1
Resource: NVIDIA A100 40GB
Desired: 12
Secondary: NVIDIA A40 24GB (4)
Justification: Dedicated inference capacity for pilot + perf tests
Contact: kevin@redwood.com
```
Matt: Networking note: prefer regional NATs and enable VPC endpoints for S3, ECR, and Secrets Manager to avoid cross-region egress. Also strongly recommend using local gateway endpoints for any on-prem links.
Anya: For state we discussed two options: Terraform Cloud remote workspace (simpler locking + UI) or classic S3 + DynamoDB. Proposal: Terraform uses remote backend (org: redwood, workspace: apac-infra) and Pulumi (self-hosted) uses encrypted S3 with KMS alias "alias/redwood-pulumi".
Sam: If we pick Terraform Cloud we avoid DynamoDB but need org seats. Ops OK?
Matt: Ops says OK for pilot but we should maintain an S3 replication snapshot to primary region daily for DR.
Anya: Terraform remote backend snippet for reference:
```
terraform {
  backend "remote" {
    organization = "redwood"
    workspaces { name = "apac-infra" }
  }
}
```
Anya: Pulumi backend (self-hosted S3) example config in CI:
```
pulumi login s3://redwood-pulumi-state-apac?region=ap-southeast-1
export PULUMI_CONFIG_PASSPHRASE="(use KMS to encrypt in workflows)"
```
Kevin: Nodegroup plan: mixed instance types g4dn -> A40 for cost-sensitive and p4 / a100 for perf. Use aws-node-termination-handler + gpu-operator daemonset for drivers. Also add kubelet extra args for GPU plugin.
Matt: CI wiring: add workflow in infra repo that runs plan on PRs and requires manual approval for main->prod merges. Example GitHub Actions steps:
```
- name: Terraform Init
  run: terraform init -backend-config=backend.hcl
- name: Plan
  run: terraform plan -var-file=apac.tfvars
- name: Request Prod Approval
  if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
  uses: repo/approval-action@v2
```
Sam: Keep pulumi pinned in CI (e.g., pulumi v3.50.0) and pin aws provider semver to avoid drift.
Anya: Validation runbook (short checklist):
- deploy a dev stack with 1 A100 node (spot) and 1 on-demand backup
- deploy smoke workload: 200 rps inference bursts for 20m
- observe GPU memory, util, pod evictions, node autoscaling behavior
- validate ECR/S3 endpoints working, measure egress bytes
- run controlled node drain to test fallback to other AZ and observe latency impact
- verify logs show kubelet GPU metrics and node exporter GPU metrics
- verify billing tags applied to resources (cost center + env)

Kevin: Handoff checklist to SRE/oncall:
- confirm Terraform Cloud workspace exists and team-level access granted
- confirm Pulumi S3 bucket encrypted + KMS key and rotation policy
- create IAM role for infra CI with least-privilege policies
- tag policies in place and automated tagging hook enabled
- alarms: GPU memory pressure > 85% (warn), > 95% (page), node GPU driver OOM
- create Grafana dashboard and add to oncall folder
- add runbook link and escalation matrix

Matt: A couple config gotchas from previous regions:
- autoscaler expects subnets tagged: kubernetes.io/cluster/<cluster-name>=shared and k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled=true
- spot instance profile needs ec2:CreateFleet permissions if using mixed instances
- ensure SSM agent allowed outbound to SSM endpoints via VPC endpoint or NAT

Anya: Security note: restrict S3 bucket policies to the infra CI role and pulumi service account. Enable bucket public access block and enforce TLS.
Sam: Ownerships: Sam -> pulumi network/bootstrap modules; Kevin -> nodegroup & driver operator; Matt -> CI + validation harness; Anya -> runbook + handoff.
Anya: Created initial Pulumi PR for vpc + endpoints -> PR #403 (link in repo).
Matt: CI pipeline created: infra-ci/apac-gpu-bootstrap (requires manual approval) and job added -> PR #404.
Kevin: Quota ticket updated: approved pending capacity verification. ETA 48h.
Sam: Target: dev stack live by EOW, prod-ready in 10-12 business days depending on quota. Keep this thread for short status updates only. Ping with small updates (PRs, approvals, deploy results). :rocket:
